verdict.rationale: Teller's first-party docs describe outbound webhooks. Developers register a URL in their app for Teller to call through the Teller Dashboard [teller-docs-7], and Teller sends events when enrollments or financial data change [teller-docs-17]. That is a genuine registrable HTTP callback mechanism. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of event types, documentation of payload signing/verification and retry behavior, programmatic (API-based) webhook registration rather than dashboard-only, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
